Zed Editor: Complete Developer Review & Analysis

Free / Open Source

Overview & Target Audience

Zed Editor (by Zed Industries) is targeted at Rust, C++, Web, and performance-focused developers demanding instant sub-millisecond typing response.

Official Website: https://zed.dev/

The Good (Pros)

  • Written in Rust and GPUI rendered at 120+ FPS for blistering fast performance
  • Native multiplayer live-collaborative editing built into the core editor
  • Extremely low memory footprint and instant startup time
  • Built-in AI model support (Claude, OpenAI, Ollama local models)

The Bad (Cons)

  • Smaller extension ecosystem compared to VS Code
  • Currently primary platform support focused on macOS and Linux (Windows in progress)
  • Less mature UI customization options

Pricing & Licensing Model

100% Free open source code editor; opt-in paid team collaboration features planned.

Verdict: Who Should Use Zed Editor?

Developers who prioritize raw typing performance, zero lag, and real-time team pairing.
